connectors.name: BATTERY connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 label; started at the end closest to the micro-USB connector (lower pin)

uncertain: A small triangle is printed beside the GND (upper) pin of P1; it may be a pin-1 marker, which would reverse the order. Not labeled '1', so the USB-nearest rule was used.
notes: Only P1 (BATTERY) has per-pin callouts. P2 (SOLAR), J10/J11/J12 headers and the J4-J7 WisBlock slots are not labeled per pin and were skipped. Board silkscreen 'RAK5005-0 V1.0'.
